premise: As the sun goes down the whole meadow says goodnight in its own way — the trees shush, the pond goes still, the grass whispers — and the moon comes up to keep watch.
inspiration: Folk goodnight litanies that name each thing in turn, turned: the place itself sings everyone to sleep, and two night friends keep watch.
lesson: At night the world takes care of you.

en-US.title: The Meadow Lullaby
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} {firefly:float loop 0.3} [softly] The sun was going down, and the meadow {all:glow 0.4 #FFD9A0} began to say goodnight. The two big trees rustled. Shhh, said their leaves. Shhh. {all:wobble 0.4} And everyone in the meadow swayed along. Down in the grass, {flower:enter} Flower said goodnight in her own way: {flower:live close hold} she folded up her petals. The pond went still as a mirror. Up on a branch sat {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl, who had slept all day — {owl:live doze hold} and was sleeping still. {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} The sky turned deep blue, and up came the moon, round and bright. {owl:live doze resume} Owl opened one eye, then the other. {sfx:hoot} "Hoo," he said softly. {owl:face happy} "My turn." {canvas:fireflies 0.5} Out in the grass, little lights blinked on. {firefly:enter} Firefly came drifting by and {firefly:glow 1 3s hold #FFE27A} lit her lantern too. [whispers] "Goodnight, meadow," said the moon. {all:face sleeping} And everyone who was there closed their eyes… {owl:face happy} {firefly:face happy} everyone but Owl and Firefly, who {firefly:live wave} waved to the moon and kept watch till morning. {canvas:fireflies stop}

es-ES.title: La nana del prado
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} {firefly:float loop 0.3} [softly] Se ponía el sol, y el prado {all:glow 0.4 #FFD9A0} empezó a darse las buenas noches. Los dos árboles grandes susurraron con sus hojas: chsss, chsss. {all:wobble 0.4} Y todo el prado se meció con ellos. En la hierba, {flower:enter} Flor dio las buenas noches a su manera: {flower:live close hold} plegó sus pétalos. La charca se quedó quieta, quieta, como un espejo. En una rama estaba {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho, que había dormido todo el día… {owl:live doze hold} y seguía durmiendo. {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} El cielo se puso azul oscuro, y salió la luna, redonda y brillante. {owl:live doze resume} Búho abrió un ojo, y luego el otro. {sfx:hoot} —Uuh —dijo bajito—. {owl:face happy} Ahora me toca a mí. {canvas:fireflies 0.5} Entre la hierba se encendieron lucecitas. {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga llegó volando y {firefly:glow 1 3s hold #FFE27A} encendió también su farolillo. [whispers] —Buenas noches, prado —dijo la luna. {all:face sleeping} Y todos los que estaban allí cerraron los ojos… {owl:face happy} {firefly:face happy} todos menos Búho y Luciérnaga, que {firefly:live wave} saludaron a la luna y se quedaron velando hasta la mañana. {canvas:fireflies stop}

ja-JP.title: のはらの こもりうた
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}{firefly:float loop 0.3}[softly]お日さまがしずんで、のはらが{all:glow 0.4 #FFD9A0}おやすみのしたくをはじめました。二本の大きな木が、さわさわ。しーっ、とはっぱ。しーっ。{all:wobble 0.4}のはらのみんなも、ゆらゆら。くさのなかでは、{flower:enter}お花が、お花らしいおやすみなさい。{flower:live close hold}はなびらを、そっととじました。池は、かがみのようにしずか。えだの上には、{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}ひるまずっとねむっていたフクロウくん。{owl:live doze hold}まだ、すやすや。{canvas:night 0.8}{sfx:crickets}空がこいあおになって、まあるいお月さまがのぼりました。{owl:live doze resume}フクロウくんは、目をひとつ、ふたつ、ぱちり。{sfx:hoot}「ホウ」 としずかに。{owl:face happy}「こんどは、ぼくのばん」 {canvas:fireflies 0.5}くさのなかに、小さな光がぽつ、ぽつ。{firefly:enter}ホタルさんもふわりとやってきて、{firefly:glow 1 3s hold #FFE27A}ちょうちんに、あかりをともしました。[whispers]「おやすみ、のはら」 とお月さま。{all:face sleeping}そこにいたみんなは、目をとじて…{owl:face happy}{firefly:face happy}フクロウくんとホタルさんだけが、{firefly:live wave}お月さまに手をふって、あさまで、みまもっていました。{canvas:fireflies stop}

de-DE.title: Gute Nacht, Wiese
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} {firefly:float loop 0.3} [softly] Die Sonne ging unter, und die Wiese {all:glow 0.4 #FFD9A0} fing an, Gute Nacht zu sagen. Die zwei großen Bäume rauschten. Schhh, machten ihre Blätter. Schhh. {all:wobble 0.4} Und alle auf der Wiese wiegten sich mit. Unten im Gras sagte {flower:enter} die Blume auf ihre Weise Gute Nacht: {flower:live close hold} Sie faltete ihre Blütenblätter zusammen. Der Teich wurde still wie ein Spiegel. Oben auf einem Ast saß {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} die Eule. Sie hatte den ganzen Tag geschlafen – {owl:live doze hold} und schlief immer noch. {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} Der Himmel wurde tiefblau, und der Mond ging auf, rund und hell. {owl:live doze resume} Die Eule öffnete ein Auge, dann das andere. {sfx:hoot} „Schuhu“, sagte sie leise. {owl:face happy} „Jetzt bin ich dran.“ {canvas:fireflies 0.5} Überall im Gras gingen kleine Lichter an. {firefly:enter} Das Glühwürmchen schwebte vorbei und {firefly:glow 1 3s hold #FFE27A} zündete auch sein Laternchen an. [whispers] „Gute Nacht, Wiese“, sagte der Mond. {all:face sleeping} Und alle, die da waren, machten die Augen zu… {owl:face happy} {firefly:face happy} alle außer der Eule und dem Glühwürmchen, die {firefly:live wave} dem Mond zuwinkten und bis zum Morgen Wache hielten. {canvas:fireflies stop}

fr-FR.title: La berceuse du pré
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} {firefly:float loop 0.3} [softly] Le soleil se couchait, et le pré {all:glow 0.4 #FFD9A0} commençait à dire bonne nuit. Les deux grands arbres bruissaient. Chut, disaient leurs feuilles. Chut. {all:wobble 0.4} Et tout le pré se balançait avec elles. En bas, dans l’herbe, {flower:enter} Fleur a dit bonne nuit à sa façon : {flower:live close hold} elle a refermé ses pétales. La mare est devenue lisse comme un miroir. Sur une branche, il y avait {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Hibou, qui avait dormi toute la journée — {owl:live doze hold} et qui dormait encore. {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} Le ciel est devenu bleu nuit, et la lune s’est levée, toute ronde et toute brillante. {owl:live doze resume} Hibou a ouvert un œil, puis l’autre. {sfx:hoot} « Hou », a-t-il fait tout bas. {owl:face happy} « À moi, maintenant. » {canvas:fireflies 0.5} Dans l’herbe, de petites lumières se sont allumées. {firefly:enter} Luciole est passée en volant et {firefly:glow 1 3s hold #FFE27A} elle a allumé sa lanterne, elle aussi. [whispers] « Bonne nuit, le pré », a dit la lune. {all:face sleeping} Et tous ceux qui étaient là ont fermé les yeux… {owl:face happy} {firefly:face happy} tous, sauf Hibou et Luciole, qui {firefly:live wave} ont fait coucou à la lune et ont veillé jusqu’au matin. {canvas:fireflies stop}

it-IT.title: La ninna nanna del prato
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} {firefly:float loop 0.3} [softly] Il sole tramontava, e il prato {all:glow 0.4 #FFD9A0} ha cominciato a dire buonanotte. Le foglie dei due grandi alberi frusciavano. Ssst, dicevano. Ssst. {all:wobble 0.4} E tutti nel prato si sono messi a dondolare con loro. Giù nell'erba, {flower:enter} Fiore ha detto buonanotte a modo suo: {flower:live close hold} ha richiuso i petali. Lo stagno è diventato liscio come uno specchio. Su un ramo c'era {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Gufo, che aveva dormito tutto il giorno — {owl:live doze hold} e dormiva ancora. {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} Il cielo è diventato blu scuro, ed è spuntata la luna, tonda e luminosa. {owl:live doze resume} Gufo ha aperto un occhio, poi l'altro. {sfx:hoot} «Uuh», ha detto piano. {owl:face happy} «Tocca a me.» {canvas:fireflies 0.5} Nell'erba si sono accese tante lucine. {firefly:enter} Lucciola è arrivata volando piano e {firefly:glow 1 3s hold #FFE27A} ha acceso anche lei la sua lanternina. [whispers] «Buonanotte, prato», ha detto la luna. {all:face sleeping} E tutti quelli che c'erano hanno chiuso gli occhi… {owl:face happy} {firefly:face happy} tutti tranne Gufo e Lucciola, che {firefly:live wave} hanno salutato la luna e sono rimasti di guardia fino al mattino. {canvas:fireflies stop}

zh-TW.title: 草地搖籃曲
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}{firefly:float loop 0.3}[softly]太陽慢慢下山了，草地{all:glow 0.4 #FFD9A0}開始說晚安。兩棵大樹沙沙響。噓——葉子說，噓——。{all:wobble 0.4}草地上的大家，也跟著輕輕搖擺。草叢裡，{flower:enter}小花用她自己的方式說晚安：{flower:live close hold}她把花瓣合了起來。池塘靜靜的，像一面鏡子。高高的樹枝上，坐著{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹，牠睡了一整天——{owl:live doze hold}到現在還在睡。{canvas:night 0.8}{sfx:crickets}天空變成深深的藍色，月亮升起來了，圓圓的，亮亮的。{owl:live doze resume}貓頭鷹睜開一隻眼睛，又睜開另一隻。{sfx:hoot}「咕——」 牠輕輕地說，{owl:face happy}「輪到我了。」 {canvas:fireflies 0.5}草叢裡，一盞一盞小小的燈亮了起來。{firefly:enter}螢火蟲飛過來，{firefly:glow 1 3s hold #FFE27A}也點亮了牠的小燈籠。[whispers]「晚安，草地。」 月亮說。{all:face sleeping}草地上的大家，都閉上了眼睛……{owl:face happy}{firefly:face happy}只有貓頭鷹和螢火蟲沒有睡。牠們{firefly:live wave}向月亮揮揮手，一直守到天亮。{canvas:fireflies stop}

zh-HK.title: 草地催眠曲
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}{firefly:float loop 0.3}[softly]太陽慢慢下山了，草地{all:glow 0.4 #FFD9A0}開始說早唞。兩棵大樹沙沙地響。噓——葉子說，噓——。{all:wobble 0.4}草地上的大家，也跟着輕輕地搖呀搖。草叢裏，{flower:enter}小花用自己的方法說早唞：{flower:live close hold}她把花瓣合起來。池塘靜靜的，像一面鏡子。樹枝上，坐着{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹。牠睡了一整天——{owl:live doze hold}到現在還在睡。{canvas:night 0.8}{sfx:crickets}天空變成深藍色，月亮升起來了，又圓又亮。月光光，照草地。{owl:live doze resume}貓頭鷹張開一隻眼，再張開另一隻。{sfx:hoot}「咕——」 牠輕輕地說，{owl:face happy}「輪到我喇。」 {canvas:fireflies 0.5}草叢裏，一點一點的小燈亮起來了。{firefly:enter}螢火蟲飛過來，{firefly:glow 1 3s hold #FFE27A}也點亮了自己的小燈籠。[whispers]「早唞，草地。」 月亮說。{all:face sleeping}草地上的大家，都閉上了眼睛……{owl:face happy}{firefly:face happy}只有貓頭鷹和螢火蟲沒有睡。牠們{firefly:live wave}向月亮揮揮手，一直守到天光。{canvas:fireflies stop}

crickets.prompt: gentle night crickets in a summer meadow, very calm and soft, realistic field recording

hoot.prompt: a single soft owl hoot at night, far and gentle, realistic field recording
